name: Image
description:
A picture in a frame of fixed ratio, with the media corner radius and a hairline rim. The
frame is reserved before the picture loads, a shimmer or the picture's colour fills it
meanwhile, and the picture fades in. A missing source or a failed load shows a fallback in
the icon language, with the alt text when the frame is wide enough. No shadow: an image
sits on its surface (R4.5).
signature: ({ src, alt, ratio, fit, position, radius, maxHeight, color, frame, hover, fallback, onStateChange, onLoad, onError, loading, decoding, className, style, ...imgProps }: ImageProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: alt
props.description: Text alternative. Required: pass `""` for a decorative image. Shown in the fallback when the frame is wide enough.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the frame, for layout.

props.name: color
props.description: The picture's dominant colour: shown while it loads instead of the shimmer, and around a contained picture.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Replaces the designed fallback shown for a missing or failed image.

props.name: fit
props.description: `cover` fills and crops (default); `contain` shows the whole picture inside the frame.

props.name: frame
props.description: A hairline rim around the frame, which keeps a pale picture's edge visible on a pale surface. Default true.

props.name: hover
props.description:
Feedback when the image is inside a link or button and that is hovered or focused:
`zoom` scales the picture inside its frame, `sheen` sweeps a glass highlight across it.
Static images never react. Still and reduced motion turn both off. Default `none`.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: The tallest the frame may be; it narrows to keep its ratio.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Called when the state changes, for example to hide a caption when the image fails.

props.name: position
props.description: `object-position`: the point kept in view when `cover` crops, such as `"50% 25%"`.

props.name: ratio
props.description: The frame's shape, reserved before the image loads so nothing moves. Default `landscape` (4:3).

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL. Empty or missing shows the empty fallback.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
